newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Weifu Fuel '96 net edges up 2.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Weifu Fuel '96 net edges up 2.7 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.37 yuan vs 0.36 yuan
Net assets per share 2.33 yuan vs 2.07 yuan
Company name: Weifu Fuel Injection Co Ltd.
NOTE: The results, calculated under Chinese accounting standards, were published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Thursday.
Based on international accounting standards, the company's net profits were 66.73 million yuan, the report said.

According to Weifu's 1995 annual report, the company posted net profits of 62.98 million yuan on turnover of 393.42 million under international standards. Per share earnings were 0.34 yuan on a fully diluted basis.
Weifu's board of directors proposed to make a cash dividend of 0.1 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, pending the approval of shareholders at a meeting on May 20, it said.
Trading in Weifu's B shares will be suspended on Thursday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has said.
